description:
Villa Abiente is a 5-bedroom luxury villa located on Cape Yamu, in one of the most picturesque areas of Phuket’s east coast.

Designed in a contemporary architectural style with Asian-inspired accents, it combines comfort, elegance, and privacy. It is an ideal choice for a couple, a small family, or a group of friends seeking a secluded and stylish getaway.

The villa’s design features light and neutral tones, with an emphasis on natural light and spaciousness. Floor-to-ceiling glazing, minimalist lines, and open-plan layouts highlight the tropical setting, while views of the bay and the sea create a sense of peace and comfort. The spacious open-plan living room combines a lounge area, a dining area for 8 guests, and a kitchen with a breakfast bar. It features a stylish sofa, TV, and air conditioning, while large glass doors open onto the pool terrace. The interior is finished with taste: light furniture, natural-material décor, modern lighting, and sea views create the atmosphere of an elegant island lounge.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped to European standards and includes everything needed for a comfortable stay:

The villa features a 12-meter infinity pool with sea views, a terrace with sun loungers and a sunbathing area. Nearby there is an outdoor dining set and a sunken lounge area for relaxed evenings. Luxury Trinity Villa is an elegant 5-bedroom villa located in the prestigious gated community of Sai Taan, in the immediate vicinity of the 5-star Laguna Phuket resort.

Created in a modern tropical style, it blends home comfort, premium service, and complete privacy. It is the ideal choice for a large family, a group of friends, or anyone seeking a high-end, secluded vacation just 1 km from the coast.

The villa’s design is executed in light and soothing tones, emphasizing spaciousness and harmony with the environment. High ceilings fill the rooms with air, while panoramic sliding doors blur the line between the interior and exterior. The view of the manicured tropical garden and the shimmering surface of the pool creates a sense of absolute peace and serenity.

The spacious and bright living room combines a relaxation area with a dining group for 10 people.

It features soft sofas for relaxed lounging, an 85-inch TV, and a modern audio system for movie nights. Large glass doors lead directly to the pool terrace, allowing you to enjoy the view without leaving the house.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped to European standards and stocked with everything necessary for comfortable living and culinary experiments:

The villa features 5 spacious bedrooms, each with direct access to the pool and garden, allowing you to start your morning with a refreshing swim. All rooms are decorated in a unified light style and are equipped with air conditioning and ensuite bathrooms.

Master Bedroom: Features a luxurious King-size bed, a spacious walk-in closet, and a bathroom with a full bathtub.

Second Bedroom: Adjoining the master bedroom, this room is equipped with a Queen-size bed and a desk. It is ideal for use as an office or a nursery for a child who needs to be close to their parents.

Third Bedroom: Features a King-size bed and an exquisite bathroom with an open-air bathtub for spa treatments under the stars.

Fourth Bedroom: Features two separate single beds — an excellent option for friends, children, or teenagers.

Fifth Bedroom: Located in a separate guest house. It features a King-size bed, a cozy sofa, and a private bathroom — for those who value maximum privacy.

The property features a large private pool surrounded by lush tropical greenery.

For comfortable relaxation, there is a cozy Sala (gazebo) with soft furniture and a ceiling fan — a perfect rescue from the midday heat.

Nearby is a BBQ zone with a bar counter and a large gas grill. This is the ideal spot for evening cocktails and al fresco dinners with loved ones.

The villa is located in the Sai Taan complex — one of the most popular and well-developed locations in Phuket.

3-minute walk to Boat Avenue — a lifestyle hub with the best restaurants, cafes, bars, massage salons, and the European supermarket Villa Market.

3-minute drive (or a 15-minute leisurely walk) to Bang Tao Beach.

Luxury Trinity Villa is a place where modern comfort meets natural harmony. It is the perfect choice for those seeking inspiration, family coziness, and a stylish vacation in Phuket in their own home by the sea.

Infinity Blue Phuket is a 4-bedroom villa with a stunning beachfront location, just 30 minutes’ drive from Phuket Airport.

Infinity Blue consists of two single-storey pavilions set on a rectangular plot that stretches between a quiet road and the beach. Entering from the parking area, you first enter the Garden Pavilion, which houses two of the villa’s bedrooms; a covered corridor between the bedrooms leads to a tropical walled garden and koi pond. A path through the garden leads to the Sea View Pavilion, which contains two more bedrooms, a kitchen, living room and dining area. At the front of this pavilion is a furnished terrace overlooking the pool and beach.

The living room is an inviting gathering place, with floor-to-ceiling glass doors that open onto the terrace and pool. This air-conditioned space is furnished with grey sofas and armchairs, positioned in front of a large flat-screen TV. The living room can be completely opened up to the terrace and the cool sea breeze. Just beyond is the dining area with sea views and a table for four. The adjoining kitchen is well equipped with modern appliances and plenty of work space on black granite countertops.

Between the villa and the beach is a 15-metre pool edged with sand and an outdoor shower. At the front of the living pavilion is a covered terrace with a fan, furnished with a dining table and sofa, the perfect place for an evening sit-down or breakfast with the sea breeze. A small paradise garden with a koi pond surrounded by palm trees and tropical plants.

All four bedrooms of Infinity Blue are spacious and bright. All have en suite bathrooms with showers and are equipped with TVs, air conditioning and ceiling fans, as well as sliding glass doors that open either onto a sea-view terrace or onto the garden.

Enjoy delicious Thai cuisine in the chic dining room or in the outdoor dining area by the pool.

name: Surin — Villa Riva · 7 bedrooms
description:
Villa Riva is a seven‑bedroom luxury villa located on the Laem Noi coastline of Koh Samui, with direct access to a secluded cove and panoramic views over the Gulf of Thailand.

Designed in an elegant Thai style with characteristic pitched roofs and a pavilion layout, it combines absolute privacy, impeccable comfort and the aesthetic of a private estate. An ideal choice for family holidays or large groups.

Villa Riva’s architecture emphasizes generous open spaces, natural materials and distinctive Thai motifs. Pitched roofs, expansive glazing and wooden details create an atmosphere of tropical luxury, while the breathtaking sea and coastline views provide a complete sense of harmony with nature.

The heart of the villa is the main building — an impressive volume with high ceilings, a double atrium and panoramic ocean views. It houses a spacious living room, a dining area for 16 guests, a lounge with large, comfortable seating and multiple relaxation and social zones finished in a refined contemporary Asian style.

The living areas flow seamlessly onto the multi‑level pool terrace, creating an ideal setting for sunset relaxation.

A contemporary show kitchen adjoins the dining room for light food preparation and serving, while the main meal prep is carried out in a separate staff kitchen. The villa is fully equipped for comfortable living, including a refrigerator, a wine cabinet and dedicated service areas for staff.

The villa offers seven bedrooms across three separate pavilions, ensuring a high degree of privacy for guests. All bedrooms are spacious, air‑conditioned and have en‑suite bathrooms, with interiors styled in an elegant Asian aesthetic.

Master bedroom: king‑size bed, private terrace with sea views and en‑suite bathroom with jacuzzi.

Second bedroom: king‑size bed, private bathroom and panoramic sea views.

Third bedroom: king‑size bed, separate pavilion and terrace for private relaxation.

Fourth bedroom: king‑size bed, private bathroom and ocean view.

Fifth bedroom: comfortable twin room suitable for teenagers or staff.

Sixth bedroom: family room in Pavilion A with access to a shaded terrace.

Seventh bedroom: children’s or additional room in Pavilion B with easy access to the beach.

The estate features a striking 32‑metre infinity pool, multi‑level terraces with sun loungers, two covered gazebos and an outdoor barbecue and dining area. Guests can also enjoy a fitness area, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, massage room, private cinema and a games room — together these amenities make Villa Riva a fully fledged private resort.

Additional facilities include a tennis court, a library and a professional service team with a private chef, villa manager and support staff.

Villa Riva is situated in Laem Noi on the northwest coast of Koh Samui — one of the island’s most tranquil and prestigious coastal areas. The villa has direct access to a beach of soft sand, ideal for secluded seaside relaxation.

Villa Riva is where tropical luxury is expressed in its most refined form — the perfect choice for those seeking impeccable service, privacy and stylish holiday living on Koh Samui.

name: Bang Tao — Villa Abiente · 5 bedrooms
description:
Villa Abiente is a 5-bedroom luxury villa located on Cape Yamu, in one of the most picturesque areas of Phuket’s east coast.

Designed in a contemporary architectural style with Asian-inspired accents, it combines comfort, elegance, and privacy. It is an ideal choice for a couple, a small family, or a group of friends seeking a secluded and stylish getaway.

The villa’s design features light and neutral tones, with an emphasis on natural light and spaciousness. Floor-to-ceiling glazing, minimalist lines, and open-plan layouts highlight the tropical setting, while views of the bay and the sea create a sense of peace and comfort. A wide lobby with a Zen-style rock garden and a signature mural adds to the feeling of quiet luxury.

The spacious open-plan living room combines a lounge area, a dining area for 8 guests, and a kitchen with a breakfast bar. It features a stylish sofa, TV, and air conditioning, while large glass doors open onto the pool terrace. The interior is finished with taste: light furniture, natural-material décor, modern lighting, and sea views create the atmosphere of an elegant island lounge.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped to European standards and includes everything needed for a comfortable stay:

The kitchen is designed both for self-catering and for breakfasts and light dinners prepared by the villa chef according to the villa menu.

The villa has 5 bedrooms, each with access to a terrace or the pool. All bedrooms are spacious, bright, and decorated in a unified style, offering complete privacy and comfort. The rooms are equipped with en-suite bathrooms and air conditioning.

Additionally, a sofa bed for one guest can be placed in the media room.

The villa features a 12-meter infinity pool with sea views, a terrace with sun loungers and a sunbathing area. Nearby there is an outdoor dining set and a sunken lounge area for relaxed evenings. It is the perfect setting for poolside breakfasts, evening relaxation, and informal gatherings under the stars.

Guests also have access to the restaurant and bar, an Olympic-size swimming pool, and a gym within the Baan Yamu estate, as well as a pier and waterfront promenade for boat trips around Phang Nga Bay.

Villa Abiente is located within the exclusive and secure Baan Yamu estate on Cape Yamu — one of the calmest and most scenic areas on Phuket’s east coast.

Three-Bedroom Sea View Villas — two-storey villas with a 3×9 m private pool, perfect for larger groups. They feature three bedrooms, spacious living areas, an extended terrace, and a private pool with panoramic sea views.

V Villas Phuket – MGallery Collection is an exclusive luxury resort featuring a collection of private pool villas perched 39 meters above sea level on a hillside overlooking the secluded Ao Yon Bay, on Phuket’s southwest coast. It offers complete privacy, exceptional service, and thoughtfully designed architecture that blends seamlessly with the natural surroundings, allowing you to enjoy panoramic views of the Andaman Sea from almost every villa.

Located just an hour’s drive from Phuket International Airport and 15 minutes from the island’s historic Old Town, the resort offers 26 elegant villas with 1, 2, 3, 4, or 6 bedrooms. Each villa includes a private infinity pool, spacious bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms and jacuzzis, floor-to-ceiling windows merging indoor and outdoor spaces, and a wooden terrace with lounge areas. Guests enjoy 24-hour personalized butler service, ensuring the highest level of comfort and attention to detail.

Yon | Ocean House — the resort’s culinary centerpiece, combining European cuisine with coastal Thai traditions. Features an art-deco-style dining room, outdoor terrace, and a wine cellar with a curated global selection.

Akoya | Star Lounge — a rooftop bar 55 meters above sea level with 360° panoramic views, signature cocktails, champagne, fine wines, and live music.

Club 39 / Poolside Dining — a relaxed poolside spot for light meals and refreshing drinks.

V Villas Spa — six spacious treatment rooms offering therapies based on pearl powder and advanced European techniques.

Main infinity pool (6.2 × 22 m) with panoramic sea views and sun loungers.

Cape Panwa Fitness & Yoga Sala — equipped with state-of-the-art Technogym equipment and offering private yoga and Pilates sessions.

V Villas Phuket – MGallery Collection is all about privacy, style, and impeccable service — ideal for a romantic escape, a family holiday, or a special celebration.

The price includes: cleaning, pool cleaning, garden maintenance, TV and Wi-Fi access, taxes and fees.

name: Bang Tao — Banyan Pool Villa · 1 bedroom
description:
Banyan Pool Villa is a 1-bedroom tropical villa located by the sea in the gated Banyan Tree Phuket complex in a picturesque part of Phuket.

Designed in a contemporary architectural style with Eastern decor elements, it combines comfort, aesthetics, and absolute privacy. The perfect choice for a couple or a secluded getaway for up to 2 people.

The villa's design features natural tones, emphasizing harmony with nature and natural light. Wooden elements and panoramic windows highlight the tropical lifestyle atmosphere, while views of the private pool and garden create a sense of peace and luxury.

The villa is equipped with coffee and tea making facilities, as well as a dining set for 2 people.

The villa offers 1 spacious bedroom with direct access to the pool and garden. The room is designed in an Eastern style and features a comfortable Japanese bed, dressing area, air conditioning, work desk, sofa, and coffee table. The bedroom opens to both an indoor bathroom and an outdoor shower.

From the luxurious interior, you step directly onto a spacious wooden terrace with a cozy shaded corner. Here you'll find a private 14 sq.m. pool with jacuzzi, sun loungers, and a dining area. It's the ideal spot for poolside relaxation, leisurely breakfasts, or dinners under the open sky.

The complex offers guests access to a beach club, restaurants, spa center, and fitness area.

The villa is located in the Banyan Tree Phuket complex — one of the island's most popular and well-appointed destinations.

Banyan Pool Villa is where modern comfort meets natural harmony and tropical luxury. The ideal choice for those seeking tranquility and stylish relaxation in Phuket for two.

name: Bang Tao — Trichada Villa 28 · 3 bedroom
description:
Trichada Villa 28 is a modern 3-bedroom villa located in the gated community of Trichada Breeze, just a 5-minute drive from Layan Beach and the prestigious Laguna area.

Designed by a renowned Thai architect, the villa perfectly combines contemporary comfort with traditional elements of tropical architecture. It is the ideal choice for a family, couple, or small group seeking privacy, aesthetics, and the natural beauty of Phuket.

The villa’s design features light, natural tones that emphasize space, natural light, and harmony with the surrounding tropics. Sloping roofs over the main living areas highlight the essence of tropical living, while the bright, airy interiors create a sense of tranquility and openness.

Floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows reveal enchanting views of the private turquoise-tiled pool and lush green garden, flooding the home with daylight.

The spacious living room combines the lounge area with the dining space. It features a comfortable sofa, a coffee table, a flat-screen TV, and a large family dining table.

Wide glass doors open directly onto the pool terrace, filling the room with natural light and creating an ideal space for relaxation and socializing. Minimalist interiors and natural wood accents bring warmth and a welcoming atmosphere.

The kitchen is equipped to European standards and fitted with all necessary appliances and utensils for a carefree stay:

The open-plan kitchen seamlessly connects to the living room, making it a functional and comfortable space for both family meals and casual cooking.

The villa offers 3 bedrooms with direct access to the garden and private pool. Each room features air conditioning, spacious wardrobes, bedside tables, and an ensuite bathroom with a modern shower.

All bedrooms are bright, spacious, and designed in a unified contemporary tropical style with natural wood elements and soft textures.

Master Bedroom: King-size bed, walk-in closet, and a large bathroom. Panoramic sliding doors open directly to the pool.

Second Bedroom: Stylish room with a Queen-size bed, thoughtfully designed lighting, private bathroom, and a view of the tropical garden.

Third Bedroom: Equipped with a King-size bed, cozy ambiance, and direct access to the pool terrace — perfect for relaxation and privacy.

At the heart of the villa lies a private pool with turquoise tiling, surrounded by tropical greenery.

Next to the pool is a sunny terrace with soft lounge chairs, sun umbrellas, and an outdoor dining zone — a perfect spot for leisurely breakfasts or romantic dinners under the stars.

The villa is located in the gated Trichada Breeze community, one of the island’s most desirable neighborhoods — just minutes away from Layan and Bang Tao beaches, as well as the world-famous Laguna Phuket resort complex.

Within a 3–10 minute drive, you’ll find a wealth of restaurants, beach clubs, cafés, and bars featuring international cuisine, along with supermarkets and wellness spas.

Trichada Villa 28 is where modern comfort meets natural harmony.

Here, you can indulge in tropical luxury, serenity, and privacy without leaving the heart of Phuket — an ideal retreat for those seeking stylish relaxation, warmth, and inspiration beneath the whisper of palm trees.

The rental price includes: cleaning service, pool maintenance, garden care, TV and Wi-Fi access, as well as all taxes and fees.

At the heart of the villa, you will find an elegant infinity pool, a Jacuzzi, and a spacious terrace with breathtaking ocean views.

Additional amenities include a private cinema, gym, and a game room with a foosball table, pool table, and table tennis. Guests can also enjoy a steam room, sauna, and massage room for ultimate relaxation.

name: Phuket — Villa Sangkachai · 5 bedroom
description:
The 5-bedroom Villa Sangkachai is set on a 2,000 sqm plot and nestled in the hills of Koh Samui, close to Choeng Mon and Chaweng beaches and steps away from the beach restaurants of Hanuman Bay.

The villa combines minimalist design with the green beauty of nature and an additional retro-classic touch in the interiors.

As soon as you enter the main level of the villa, you will be greeted by breathtaking views of the island, sea and sunset, which can be seen from the living and dining areas. The L-shaped saltwater infinity pool measures 22m x 5m x 1.8m with views of the horizon.

The rooftop terrace can be closed or opened depending on the weather and has its own bar and dining area for 10 people, along with sun loungers and a Sonos sound system for harmonious nights under the stars. A relaxing spa area with massage tables, a Jacuzzi, a steam room and a cold plunge pool offers guests a pleasant retreat, while a fitness room gives guests the opportunity to work out in privacy. The villa also has a games room with a pool table and a modern cinema room with a large screen.

Villa Sangkachai has 5 bedrooms that can accommodate up to 10 guests. At the top level of the villa is the 90 sq m master suite. This master suite features a balcony, his and hers walk-in closets, a king-size bed and an en-suite bathroom with an oval bathtub, double vanities, a Japanese toilet and both an indoor and outdoor rain shower. Another master suite is located separately from the public areas on the pool level. The stairs then lead up to three guest bedrooms, all of which have sea views, king-size beds and en-suite bathrooms.

Staff services (available from 7 AM to 10 PM), including a private chef (food not included).

The 4-bedroom Baan Bua Sawan Villa is part of the gated Dhevatara Residence complex, located on the prestigious northern shore of Samui, steps away from the beach.

It features four spacious and comfortable bedrooms, picturesque ocean views, an immaculate blue-tiled pool and gorgeous décor. The open-plan kitchen is fully equipped with modern appliances and a spacious dining area.

The master bedroom features a king-size four-poster bed, separate dressing room and a double bathroom with sea views. Guest bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms, two with double beds and one with twin beds.

The infinity pool measures 4.7m x 12m x 1.8m and has a shallow area for children.

The villa is divided into several bedroom pavilions with private roof gardens and sun terraces over multiple levels, offering fantastic ocean views.

The open-plan living area with large sofas, air conditioning and a ceiling fan is connected to the dining area. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need.

The infinity pool with Jacuzzi (4.7m x 21.7m x 1.7m deep) has sun loungers and an outdoor gazebo.

The master bedroom is located on the first level - beach level. It has a king-size bed, satellite TV, walk-in closet, private gazebo, minibar, direct access to the jacuzzi and the beach, fan, air conditioning, safe, portable sound system.

Two bedrooms with king-size beds and private gazebos are located on the second level.

Two bedrooms are located on the third level. They are equipped with king-size beds and balconies.

The villa has two swimming pools: one on the lower level (5.7 m x 15.7 m x 1.8 deep), the second infinity pool (4 m x 15.3 m x 1.1 m deep) is located on the upper level. The pool has an outdoor gazebo and dining table, sun loungers with umbrellas.

The villa consists of two pavilions, the first of which contains two interconnecting bedrooms, ideal for families. The master bedroom has a double bed and an en-suite shower room, while the adjacent second bedroom has two single beds with an additional bunk bed. The second pavilion has a large open plan living and dining area with a fully equipped kitchen and folding glass doors that open onto a 2.6m x 11.6m x 1.8m infinity pool.

Upstairs, on the mezzanine level, there is a TV room that can easily be converted into a third double bedroom, there is also a full shower room.

Headland Villas Estate is located next to the InterContinental Samui Baan Taling Ngam Resort, which has a beachfront restaurant and water sports. White sand beach shared with InterContinental Samui Baan Taling Ngam Resort.

This modern villa is surrounded by lush greenery and has incredible views from every room.

The indoor living room with a large sofa with projectors with retractable screens, air conditioning and a ceiling fan is combined with a dining area. The outdoor (pool) area has a living room with two sofas with projectors with retractable screens, a fan and a sound system. The indoor dining area can accommodate up to 22 people; the outdoor dining area can accommodate up to 8 people.

The villa has a massage sala and a fully equipped gym, an infinity 16.5-meter pool and Jacuzzi with a shallow area for children, a terrace, and a bar.

Four king-size bedrooms with large en-suite bathrooms, one bedroom with two single beds. All rooms have private balconies, floor-to-ceiling glass windows and doors, remote-controlled lighting and blinds.

The spacious living room with dining area is equipped with ceiling fans, sound systems and work space, the villa has air conditioning and a closed media room with entertainment systems. The kitchen is fully equipped with all the necessary equipment for a comfortable stay.

Salt water swimming pool 15m x 6.20m x 1.6m; there is a shallow area for children at the end of the pool (60cm x 2.7m); there are 4 sun loungers on the terrace.

The villa has a yoga room, a treadmill and table tennis; a massage room with 2 massage beds.

The bedrooms are spacious and equipped with bathrooms. Two bedrooms with queen-size beds, two with two single beds (convertible into super king). The fifth bedroom can be converted into a children's room thanks to two single beds and two bunk beds.

The spacious living room is combined with a dining area and has an exit through floor-to-ceiling sliding doors to the terrace by the 16-metre infinity pool with salt water.

The 4-bedroom, two-storey Mullion Cove Villa is located on a hilltop with exceptional views of Bophut Bay and Koh Phangan.

The villa is almost 750 square meters with an 11.6-meter swimming pool surrounded by a manicured lawn. There is a barbecue area. The living room, dining area and kitchen are open plan in cool light colors. The kitchen is fully equipped for comfortable living, there is a bar counter.

Air-conditioned bedrooms with high wooden ceilings, full-length sliding glass doors, private balconies and bathrooms with showers and stone bathtubs (there are bathrooms in three bedrooms).

name: Phuket — Villa Solana · 7 bedroom
description:
On the picturesque north-east coast of Koh Samui, this seven-bedroom villa is ideal for 14 guests. It occupies a beautiful hillside location, offering stunning views of the sea and distant islands from each of its three levels.

The interior of the villa harmoniously connects the large living and dining area with a modern kitchen. From here you go out onto a spacious terrace with a beautiful swimming pool and an area for dining under the stars. A special charm is given by the relaxation area on the top of the cliff, where the pool offers a breathtaking view of the sea.

On the upper floor is the master bedroom and two interconnecting bedrooms, creating a cozy self-contained suite. Four guest bedrooms are located on the lower level. The bedrooms are decorated in stylish shades of gray and brown, and the bathrooms are equipped with rain showers.

For entertainment, there is a private cinema, a games room and a “poker” room with a bar and a large screen for watching sports. Active holiday lovers can use the gym, sauna and steam room, as well as do yoga on the pool terrace, enjoying the sounds of the waves and sea views.

name: Phuket — Villa Baan Puri · 6 bedroom
description:
A beachfront 6 bedroom villa on the tranquil Lipa Noi Beach overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.

As you enter the villa, past a koi pond, you will find yourself in a spacious living room with dining area where you can enjoy breathtaking views of the 29-metre pool and the ocean. To the left of the living room, extending down to the beach, are four bedrooms on the ground floor, each offering privacy and luxury with different views of the sea, pool and tropical gardens. Two spacious bedrooms are located upstairs and open onto a large terrace. The interiors are designed in a modern Thai style with large comfortable beds and armchairs.

The master bedroom with stunning views opens onto a private terrace just steps from the sea. The bedroom has a king-size four-poster bed, a fold-out bed for two children, with soft chairs. The bathroom has a terrazzo bathtub.

Three guest bedrooms overlook the garden, one with two large twin beds that can be converted into a king-size bed.

The two ocean-facing guest bedrooms on the upper floor open onto a wide shared terrace with wooden loungers overlooking the pool and beach. These two rooms have king-size beds and ensuite bathrooms with twin vanities, bathtubs and separate showers.

At the far end of the pool is a comfortably furnished sunken sala and pool bar, which opens out onto a wide coastal lawn.

The lawn between the pool and the beach has plush sofas and armchairs for watching the sunset or enjoying candlelit dinners under a canopy of soaring palms and a starry sky.

name: Phuket — Villa Tawantok · 5 bedroom
description:
The 5-bedroom villa is located right on the beach. Next to the beach there is an 11-meter private pool with a gazebo, where you can enjoy a light breakfast or a gourmet dinner from the chef. Behind the pool there is a green garden with amazing flowering lilawadi trees.

Along the garden there is a spacious bright living room with comfortable soft sofas and panoramic glass doors that offer a view of the garden on one side and the sea on the other. The dining area can comfortably accommodate 10 people at a large wooden table. From the dining area, a spiral staircase leads to another small living room, which can be used as a games room or a massage room.

From the master bedroom, you can see panoramic views of the turquoise sea. Behind the sleeping area there is a spacious living room and a dressing room. There is a large bathroom with a tropical shower, a vanity table and a free-standing bathtub.

The four guest bedrooms are almost identical, three of them have king-size double beds, one bedroom has two single beds. Each bedroom has a desk and chair, a private bathroom, and on the veranda there are chairs to enjoy morning coffee with an amazing view of the garden and the sea.

There are two such villas, they are completely identical, located next to each other and mirror each other. If necessary, they can be combined and form one 10-bedroom villa for a large family or a group of friends. Near the entrance to the villas there is a tennis court, which is common for both villas.

name: Phuket — Villa Suralai · 6 bedroom
description:
The 6-bedroom villa is nestled high among the lush green hills above the popular resort area of ​​Samui Bophut.

The villa has been designed to take in stunning views from all angles.

The 25-metre infinity pool is flanked by a wide terrace with comfortable sun loungers and parasols. To one side of the pool is a fan-powered gazebo with a vaulted ceiling and wide cushioned seating that surrounds a dining table for 10. There is a swim-up bar with sunken bar stools.

The manicured lawn with palm trees that stretches out to the pool is the perfect setting for parties and romantic weddings.

The living room is decorated with a white leather L-shaped sofa, while plush armchairs are scattered around the 75-inch flat-screen Smart TV with satellite channels.

Floor-to-ceiling glass doors open onto a wide terrace, providing uninterrupted panoramic views.

Two master bedrooms with a king-size four-poster bed, a spacious bathroom with cool gray ceramic tiles, carved teak elements, double vanities and a free-standing oval terrazzo bathtub. One bedroom is on the upper level and has a private balcony with a glass balustrade. The second bedroom opens directly onto the pool terrace and garden.

A guest bedroom with two single beds is located on the lower level. The room opens onto the landscaped garden. The en suite bathroom has a vanity and a round terrazzo bathtub.

Three identical guest bedrooms with a king-size bed are on one level and share a wide terrace. The bathrooms are tiled in cool grey and feature double vanities, rain showers and separate toilets.

description:
Situated on the golden sands of Laem Noi Beach overlooking the Gulf of Thailand, this 3-bedroom single-storey villa is the perfect getaway for a relaxing holiday; its three bedrooms comfortably accommodate six adults and one child. Secluded and surrounded by tropical forest and rustling palm trees, Villa Neung offers exclusive and comfortable oceanfront living; it also boasts breathtaking views of the neighbouring island.

The property is located in a small estate of five beachfront villas with parking for two cars directly outside each villa. With a security guard at the entrance, 24-hour CCTV, alarm systems and safes, the villa guarantees your complete safety and offers the utmost privacy.

The open, spacious living area is conveniently located next to the dining area and features a fully equipped kitchen. There is also an outdoor dining area with BBQ facilities, ceiling fans and a seating area by the pool.

Kitchen: Equipped with an oven, refrigerator, Kuppersbusch coffee machine, juicer, blender, toaster, rice cooker, electric kettle, electric stove, water dispenser, as well as necessary kitchen utensils, cutlery and glasses.

Total surface area: 772 sq.m (ground); Total floor area: 209 sq.m (villa)

name: Phuket — Villa Akuvara · 4 bedroom
description:
The 4-bedroom villa is located on the southern section of the beautiful and quiet beach of Samui, Lipa Noi Beach, in close proximity to the Gulf of Thailand.

The 13-meter swimming pool is just a few steps from the beach. At the end of the terrace with sun loungers, there is a small cozy gazebo.

The spacious living room with glass doors opening onto the pool terrace has a comfortable sofa and armchairs arranged around a teak coffee table and a large TV with satellite channels. Next to it there is another small room also with a TV and a chess board.

Between these two rooms is a well-equipped kitchen with access to the main living room.

The master bedroom takes pride of place in the villa, with huge sliding glass doors that provide direct access to the pool and stunning ocean views. The king-size bed is complemented by two large, cozy chairs adorned with beautiful silk pillows. The room is equipped with an iPod/iPhone docking station and a large flat-screen TV with DVD player. The bathroom has a double vanity and shower, but the highlight is the square outdoor tub for two.

The two guest bedrooms are smaller than the master, but no less comfortable. One has a king-size bed, the other has two single beds. Both have en-suite bathrooms with showers.

The third guest room is located above the garage and is equipped with all the amenities to make it self-contained. The room has a king-size bedroom with a sitting area, as well as a spacious balcony overlooking the rest of the villa and the sea. The kitchenette has a breakfast bar, refrigerator, microwave and two-burner electric stove. The bedroom has a large TV with DVD and CD player with radio and iPod/iPhone docking station.

description:
Surrounded by lush tropical gardens and breathtaking views of the Gulf of Thailand, Villa Raku is located in the tranquil Maenam area of ​​Koh Samui, Thailand.

The spacious living and dining areas have impressive views of the sea and pool.

The kitchen is equipped with top-notch appliances and everything you need to create culinary masterpieces.

Outside, the terrace features an L-shaped pool, sun loungers and a Sala that can accommodate ten people, all surrounded by breathtaking views.

The master bedroom features a living area, walk-in closet and bathroom with two rain showers. Guest bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms. One of the guest bedrooms is equipped with two bunk beds for children.

L-shaped pool (length 16 m, width 10 m, depth from 0.8 to 2 m)

Staff services (available from 7 AM to 10 PM), including a private chef (food not included).

name: Phuket — Villa Hin · 5 bedroom
description:
Villa Hin is located in an outstanding private villa estate on the north-east coast of Samui. Situated on a hillside, just a few minutes’ walk from the beautiful beach at Hanuman Bay and beach restaurants.

The villa is designed to make the most of the space and allow the cool breezes typical of the tropical climate to flow freely. The villa is equipped with modern amenities, and this, together with the beautiful and unique architecture, makes it an ideal place to stay.

The outdoor living area is located right next to the pool, it has a bar and modern comfortable sofas, a dining area with a large dining table that can accommodate up to eight people. The kitchen is fully equipped and equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay.

Five bedrooms with different views of the ocean, pool or beautifully maintained gardens. Each room has a comfortable bed, a bathroom and a living room equipped for maximum comfort.

description:
The 6-bedroom duplex villa Ban Mekkala is located on Laem Sor Beach, Samui and features beach access, a T-shaped pool, home cinema, spa massage room, BBQ area and stunning views of the azure seascape.

The main living space is located on the top floor of the main pavilion - it is an open-plan living room, dining area, fully equipped kitchen and balcony.

A stone path leads to a stunning pool pavilion where you can enjoy gourmet meals prepared by your personal Thai chef.

The ground floor features a central swimming pool and courtyard garden. Six bedrooms, including two master bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms.

On the ground floor of the main house are bedrooms five and six, as well as a steam room. There are four more separate bedroom pavilions in the garden. Bedrooms three and four are either side of the central lawn, these rooms have an additional outdoor shower in their own courtyard. Bedrooms one and two are the master bedrooms and the largest of all, with their own surround sound stereo systems that can be isolated from the system in the main house.

name: Phuket — Villa Chi · 5 bedroom
description:
The 5-bedroom villa is located on a white sand beach, fringed by swaying coconut palms, with clear sapphire blue seas lazily lapping the shore.

Along one side of the villa is a 20-metre swimming pool with a Jacuzzi and cozy gazebos with stunning ocean views. On the other side are shared tropical gardens and a wooden deck with sun loungers by the pool on the seafront.

The spacious living area features a large sofa, comfortable soft armchairs, coffee tables and a large TV.

The dining area features a modern open-plan kitchen with separate black stone serving and breakfast counters, and an elegant glass-topped dining table for 10.

The spa and massage room are located on the level below the dining area, next to the gym.

All five bedrooms are bright and cosy, with king-size beds and en-suite bathrooms with rain showers or bathtubs. Creamy white floors contrast with dark wood Thai-style furniture. All bedrooms have air conditioning, ceiling fans, personal safes, flat-screen TVs and Bose or Sony sound systems.

The spacious and elegant master bedroom opens to the main courtyard and features a four-poster bed, as well as a large closet and dressing area. The light-flooded bathroom overlooks the pool and sea and features a freestanding ceramic bathtub and black stone shower. The double vanity is finished in the same striking black stone.

One guest bedroom is located next to the main one and also has access to the main courtyard.

Separately at the end of the house are two bedrooms on the ground floor, each with its own garden terrace and sitting area. These two rooms are also self-contained with a fridge, microwave, kettle and coffee maker.

Upstairs is a large bedroom with access to its own spacious roof terrace with sun loungers, a living room and sea views. The bathroom has a rain shower and a vanity unit.

Pool: 20 x 5 x 1.5 meters + Jacuzzi, shared pool on the beach 25 x 2.5 x 1.8 meters

name: Phuket — Villa Element of 8 · 6 bedroom
description:
A 6-bedroom villa is nestled on a hillside in the southwest of Koh Samui.

The 14-meter pool is surrounded by a sun terrace with a lawn and sun loungers shaded by umbrellas. Nearby, a cozy thatched-roof gazebo features large comfortable cushions and a low wooden coffee table. This shaded retreat is perfect for casual dining or unwinding with a rejuvenating massage.

On the beach, there is a dedicated barbecue area with plush seating, ideal for creating unforgettable evenings under the stars, accompanied by the sound of the waves.

The main living and dining areas are bathed in natural light, featuring vaulted ceilings, white walls, and floor-to-ceiling glass doors that can be opened to let in the cool sea breeze and reveal breathtaking views.

Each of the six king-size bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms is bright and elegant, featuring floor-to-ceiling glass doors and terraces overlooking the sea. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning, safes, Wi-Fi, and satellite TV.

A spacious covered terrace spans the length of the villa, connecting the living area and open kitchen to the master bedroom, which is privately situated at the far end of the villa.

Stairs lead down to the lower level terrace with access to four spacious double bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms. The sixth bedroom is separate and can be reached by stairs from the main pool terrace and even has its own entrance from the car park.

name: Phuket — Villa Sila Varee · 5 bedroom
description:
A 5-bedroom villa is perched high on a tropical hillside in the unspoiled Laem Set area on the southern coast of Koh Samui, offering panoramic views of the Gulf of Siam and neighboring islands.

The 9.5-meter infinity saltwater pool is secured with sturdy glass balustrades. Escape the tropical heat and refresh yourself while enjoying views of the ocean below or the jungle-covered hillside above. A large limestone sun terrace with five loungers invites you to soak up the sun.

The spacious living room features picturesque ocean views. The interior decor includes Anglo-Burmese tables, Tibetan furniture, Balinese teak coffee tables, contemporary artworks, sisal rugs, and custom-made sofas. Handcrafted light fixtures highlight the vaulted, rattan-clad ceilings. The kitchen is designed in a modern style. A dining table for four is located indoors, while a massive Balinese dining table seating twelve takes pride of place on the covered terrace.

All five bedrooms are air-conditioned and feature en-suite bathrooms with rain showers and walk-in closets, digital safes, Wi-Fi and satellite TV, DVD players, yoga mats, refrigerators and tea and coffee making facilities.

One master bedroom with a king-size four-poster bed is located in a separate two-story building, featuring 3.5-meter-wide windows overlooking the infinity pool and ocean, and a private sundeck with two sun loungers. A living room with a sofa and armchair, coffee table and hidden flat-screen TV. An en-suite bathroom with twin vanities, a Jacuzzi and two showers, one of which is outside and built into the rocky hillside. Feel at one with nature in this blissful sanctuary and let the serene ocean views create your perfect day.

The second master bedroom is almost identical with the same magnificent interior, all the amenities and breathtaking views.

The two guest bedrooms are located next to each other and look out onto the infinity pool and sun terrace. The rooms have two single beds that can easily be converted into a double bed if needed. With bathrooms built into the rock on the hillside.

Another guest bedroom with a king-size bed with stunning views of the hillside and the ocean right from your bed. This room is slightly smaller than the others and is hidden under the rest of the villa. The en-suite bathroom has a rain shower.

Dedicated villa manager (butler) available to assist with any requests.

Full-time housekeeping staff to maintain cleanliness and comfort.

Breakfast ingredients included. Grocery shopping service available for lunch and dinner preparation upon request.

description:
A 6-bedroom beachfront villa located on the southern stretch of Samui's beautiful and serene Lipa Noi Beach.

Next to the pool, you'll find a spacious beachside gazebo, large enough to accommodate a long dining table with side benches, an L-shaped sofa, and two armchairs, all offering stunning sea views. Ceiling fans under the vaulted roof keep the space cool and comfortable.

The 15-meter swimming pool is just steps away from the beach, inviting you to enjoy the ultimate seaside experience.

Surrounding the villa is a lush garden filled with tall coconut palms and manicured lawns, creating a tropical paradise. Birds and butterflies flutter between the greenery, adding to the tranquil atmosphere. Children will be thrilled with the playground nestled in the garden. A highlight among the villa's amenities is the private tennis court, which also features a basketball hoop in one corner for added fun.

The dining room, adjacent to the kitchen, has a large square table that seats 12, as well as a spacious breakfast bar. There are four refrigerators, including a wine fridge, and a coffee machine. The living room has huge sofas and armchairs, a TV, and a DVD player.

The six bedrooms are arranged in pairs in three spacious bungalows. Each pair has a connecting door, making the bungalow ideal for families, although these doors can be locked for privacy if required. Each room has air conditioning and a shaded veranda with a sofa and armchair. All six bedrooms have spacious bathrooms with double vanities and rain showers. However, the pride of the house are the elegant freestanding bathtubs, each set under a glass roof.

Three bedrooms are with a king-size bed, opposite the bed is a sofa with colorful cushions, and in the corner is an elegant table and chair made of teak wood.

Two rooms with two single beds, although smaller in size, are no less comfortable. If desired, the beds can be joined to form a double. One of these bedrooms has a wide-screen TV and DVD player.

Another guest bedroom with a pair of bunk beds. This room also has a TV and DVD player.

We are pleased to present a luxurious 8-bedroom oceanfront villa—an exclusive beachfront estate with two swimming pools, blending elegance and tropical luxury while overlooking one of Koh Samui's finest beaches, Lipa Noi, on its picturesque western coast.

This villa consists of two adjoining modern properties, offering eight en-suite double bedrooms, comfortably accommodating up to 16 guests. Perfect for large groups and family vacations, the villa provides everything you need for a beachfront escape: two infinity pools, expansive terraces, an outdoor bar, a sophisticated living and dining area, a billiard table, and manicured lawns that gently slope down to the beach.

The central beachfront villa features separate living and dining spaces, a landscaped garden, and views of the 15-meter L-shaped infinity pool and lawns leading to the shore.

On the other hand, the three-level oceanfront villa at the rear is centered around an eight-meter infinity pool and a terrace with a gazebo. The villa is self-contained and has a fully equipped kitchen, living room and games room with a full-size pool table.

The décor reflects a contemporary style enriched with Asian accents and artifacts. Each bedroom is equipped with a comfortable king-size bed, crisp white linens, and luxurious en-suite bathrooms featuring tropical rain showers or bathtubs.

The lawned gardens and beach are ideal for yoga or massages, which can be arranged by the villa manager. Relaxing in such an inspiring setting will leave you feeling refreshed and invigorated. The villa’s incredible location makes it a popular venue for events, weddings and celebrations.

A dedicated villa manager, concierge, and chef are on hand to deliver an unforgettable experience and a carefree stay. We’ll take care of every detail, from meal planning and spa treatments to organizing tours and shopping trips. Your chef will transform dining into a true pleasure, preparing authentic Thai dishes with fresh, local ingredients as well as exquisite international cuisine. Special dietary needs and personalized menus for children can also be accommodated to ensure everyone enjoys their vacation.

The open-plan living spaces make the villa an ideal retreat for family vacations and large groups of up to 14 people.

This beautiful low-rise villa, nestled among rural coconut plantations, offers a secluded tropical paradise for a peaceful getaway. The two-story main house features a spacious air-conditioned living room and three double bedrooms, all overlooking the sea.

From here, a wide lawn garden stretches directly to the water’s edge, with a 7.5-meter swimming pool on one side. Opposite, there are two beachfront or garden-facing bedrooms, each with a double bed and an en-suite bathroom.

At the heart of the villa lies a spacious covered gazebo and an open-air dining terrace — a perfect spot for long lazy breakfasts, poolside barbecues, or pre-dinner cocktails while admiring the sunsets over Koh Samui's southern coast.

The villa is tastefully designed with cool gray ceramic floors, rustic woven rugs, walls in muted olive and taupe tones, and comfortable furniture made of warm textured fabrics. The bathrooms feature light stone vanities and tropical rain showers. Throughout the villa, Asian-style paintings and artifacts add vibrant accents.

The villa is fully equipped with everything you need. Additionally, a dedicated villa manager and a personal chef are at your service to take care of everything, from menu planning and shopping to arranging spa treatments and excursions, ensuring your stay is seamless and enjoyable.

description:
Located on an exclusive hillside plot near Kamala Beach, Villa Saan spans four levels and boasts an impeccable design with thoughtful details.

The villa features a stunning 19-meter aquamarine-tiled pool with an integrated jacuzzi, surrounded by spacious terraces that are perfect for outdoor relaxation. Inside, you'll find a grand living and dining area, a home cinema, a games room with a pool table, a fully equipped gym, and a luxurious spa. The eight elegantly furnished bedrooms, each with a private balcony offering breathtaking sea views and an ensuite bathroom, provide ultimate privacy and comfort.

On one side of the entrance is the living room, a spacious and airy area with plush white sofas, thoughtfully positioned to capture the sunset views through floor-to-ceiling glass walls. At the back of the room, there is a TV lounge and a large bookshelf.

On the opposite side of the entrance, there is a games room featuring a pool table, bar, and entertainment area, adjacent to the home cinema, which is fitted with a projector screen and ultra-comfortable seating for an authentic cinematic experience.

The lower level of the villa houses a state-of-the-art gym with premium fitness equipment and a spa area for complete relaxation.

Extending in front of the living area, the 19-meter infinity pool with an integrated jacuzzi is the villa’s focal point. Along the pool terrace, sun loungers invite guests to soak in the tropical ambiance.

In the corner of the terrace, near the games room, is a shaded lounge area with stylish furniture, a furnished sala, and a barbecue zone, perfect for enjoying sunset cocktails before grilling up a delicious seafood feast.

The spacious master bedroom, featuring a king-size bed, is designed in an elegant and sophisticated style, complemented by a white loveseat and ottoman. Behind the workspace, a walk-in wardrobe and a luxurious ensuite bathroom are discreetly hidden. The rain shower, surrounded by glass panels, creates a sense of an open-air experience. The master suite also boasts a private jacuzzi plunge pool with panoramic views and a double bathtub on its secluded terrace.

Two king-size guest bedrooms occupy the top floor of one of the pavilions. Each room offers breathtaking sea views, a private terrace, a wardrobe, and a lavish ensuite bathroom with a double bathtub. One of the bedrooms also features a side terrace with a decorative reflecting pool and an outdoor shower, creating an exclusive retreat-like ambiance.

Four guest bedrooms are arranged side by side beneath the pool terrace, each with a sea- and garden-view balcony and a private ensuite bathroom with a rain shower.

Two rooms feature twin beds that can be converted into a king-size bed.

On the ground floor, next to the fitness center, lies the eighth guest bedroom, also featuring a super king-size bed and an ensuite bathroom.

name: Bang Tao — Grand Villa Noi · 5 bedrooms
description:
The 5-bedroom Grand Villa Noi beautifully blends modern elements with traditional Thai architecture. Its bold design with glass walls offers unobstructed views of the surrounding natural beauty, creating the perfect atmosphere for a luxurious beach vacation.

Located on a 10-kilometer stretch of untouched beach in Phang Nga Province, Grand Villa Noi occupies a prime spot on the white sands of Natai Beach. The villa is a peaceful oasis, surrounded by lush greenery, tropical gardens, and tall trees swaying in the wind. The villa offers breathtaking sea views that you can enjoy throughout your stay.

The main building of the villa is spread across two levels, designed in a modern style with glass walls. It features a spacious open-plan kitchen with a long dining table. Above the kitchen are the master bedroom and one guest bedroom, making it ideal for families with children. The other three bedrooms are separate pavilions, connected by a wooden terrace.

The air-conditioned family living room is located at the front of the villa. Panoramic windows provide an endless view of the ocean. The living room includes a variety of board games, a billiard table, a dedicated children's area, a small library, a writing desk, and a wine cooler.

The modern open-plan kitchen occupies one corner of the main building and smoothly transitions into the dining area with a long eight-seat table. Floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors allow you to choose between alfresco or air-conditioned dining, with a view of the pool and terrace.

In front of the villa is a spacious wooden deck terrace that frames the landscape pool. Around the pool, sun loungers are strategically placed, while tropical trees provide natural shade, protecting you from the sun.

The outdoor living area is set amidst a lush tropical garden and has direct access to the soft sands of Natai Beach—a pristine 10-kilometer stretch of coastline.

All five luxurious bedrooms in Grand Villa Noi are spacious and equipped with double beds and ensuite bathrooms. Each is designed with privacy in mind, offering stunning sea views, ceiling fans, and air-conditioning.

The master bedroom is located on the upper level. It features floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass doors leading to a balcony with comfortable chairs, offering magnificent views of the sea. In one corner of the room is a round double bed, facing a flat-screen TV. The spacious ensuite bathroom includes a jacuzzi and a separate rain shower.

name: Bang Tao — Villa Baan Taley Rom · 6 bedroom
description:
The 6-bedroom villa Baan Taley Rom, located in a coastal region known for its pristine beaches, offers a secluded retreat away from bustling Phuket while remaining within easy reach of the island’s attractions and international airport.

At the heart of Baan Taley Rom is a spacious open-plan living room with breathtaking sea views. It is furnished with plush sofas and armchairs, as well as a modern wooden dining table. The living area can be fully opened to the courtyard and pool terrace, creating an expansive indoor-outdoor space. A fully equipped guest kitchen with a bar counter adjoins a wine room with ample storage.

The gym and spa are housed in separate rooms. The gym features a modern elliptical trainer, stationary bike, and cable weight system, while the massage room provides a calming ambiance with a comfortable massage table. Between these rooms, guests will find a bathroom, steam room, and jacuzzi.

At the center of the villa is a veranda with plush armchairs and sofas, seamlessly connecting to the spacious poolside terrace, which is lined with sun loungers and bean bags.

Beyond the sleek black-tiled infinity pool, a vast, manicured lawn shaded by towering coconut palms leads to a beachfront gazebo, perfect for relaxation. The outdoor area also features a built-in grill with an outdoor bar.

Each of the six ensuite bedrooms is air-conditioned and furnished with a double bed, writing desk, and built-in wardrobe. All bedrooms offer panoramic sea views and direct access to verandas and balconies through sliding glass doors.

The master suite, located in a private pavilion, features a luxurious king-size bed and a walk-through closet that separates the sleeping area from the ensuite bathroom. The bathroom is equipped with a tropical rain shower, his-and-hers sinks, and a freestanding bathtub.

description:
The 5-bedroom villa Baan Paradise is located on top of a hill in the southern part of Patong Beach, near the road leading to the beautiful Karon Beach.

The spacious living room features floor-to-ceiling windows, seamlessly connected to the dining area, and opens onto a terrace with sun loungers, offering breathtaking views from the 14-meter panoramic pool.

This villa boasts two fully equipped kitchens. The main level features a large open-plan kitchen next to the dining area, while the lower-level kitchen can be used for late-night snacks or as a maid’s kitchen. Both kitchens are equipped with all necessary appliances.

Away from the main entertainment area, on the lower level, there is a game room. The room includes a 60-inch wall-mounted plasma TV, a home theater system with surround sound, and a DVD player with the latest movies and games for you and your children. Enjoy a game of billiards on the American-style pool table.

The villa offers five spacious master bedrooms, all with stunning sea views on the western side. Each bedroom is both spacious and cozy, featuring its own ensuite bathroom.

description:
The 4-bedroom Laemsingh Villa 3 is located on a cape between two beaches, offering stunning views of Surin Beach in a secure gated community.

The villa is spacious and bright, designed in a modern style with large floor-to-ceiling windows, providing an incredible ocean view. There is both an indoor and outdoor dining area, with an outdoor terrace leading to the pool and breathtaking sea views. The large, modern kitchen offers all the amenities for comfortable living.

The villa features an infinity pool, a small glass pool with a Jacuzzi, and a spacious terrace with sun loungers.

All four bedrooms have private bathrooms, ensuring privacy and seclusion for all guests. On the upper level, the spacious master bedroom includes a small living area, an office, and a terrace with an ocean view. Another bedroom on the main level can be furnished with either a double bed or two single beds.

On the lower level, there are two additional bedrooms and a mini-gym. The third bedroom can be furnished with either a double bed or two single beds. The ground floor features a kitchen, powder room, separate dining and living area, and opens onto two courtyards; one with a tiled pool and outdoor shower. The second floor features two bedrooms, each with a spacious bathroom and private balcony; one has a king-size bed, while the other king-size bed can be separated into twin beds upon request. The third floor features a master bedroom with stunning ocean views. The master bedroom has an en-suite bathroom, spacious walk-in closet, a second living area with a bar and a balcony.

The villa is equipped with modern amenities, including TVs and DVD players, a dishwasher and a coffee maker. The balconies and courtyards are furnished with Kenkoon furniture, and the villa is decorated with art. There is also a range of exercise machines for your convenience.

The beach is accessible from the villa through the rear gate. The villa is located at the end of Kata Noi village, where there are many restaurants, shops and a pharmacy.

The three-bedroom Patio Duplex Malaiwana Residence is located just 20 minutes’ drive from Phuket Airport and within easy reach of several of Phuket’s top attractions and entertainment options, including golf, spas, restaurants, beach bars and shopping malls. Throughout your stay, a team of staff, including a talented Thai chef and an English-speaking manager, will ensure that your every need is met both inside and outside the estate.

The Patio Duplex Residence occupies the first and second floors of three-storey apartment buildings at Malaiwana. In each Patio Duplex, a central staircase connects the three upper-floor bedrooms to the open-plan living, dining and kitchen areas. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors in the living area open out onto the pool terrace, and beyond that is a paved terrace overlooking the garden. The master bedroom and one of the upper-floor guest bedrooms overlook the sea and have stunning views from their balconies.

The master bedroom is located on the top floor and has a private balcony with sea views. A spacious walk-in closet leads to a marble bathroom with a freestanding bathtub. The room is equipped with a king-size bed. One of the guest bedrooms is located next to the master and they are almost identical. The second guest room is on the same floor, in another part of the house.

On the first floor there is another room that has sliding glass doors that lead to the pool terrace. The room has many uses and can be converted into a media room for movie screenings, an office when you need to work, or an additional bedroom. A private marble bathroom, closet and TV provide additional convenience.

Nearby is access to a beach cove ideal for snorkelling. Three kilometres away is Kamala, a traditional fishing village with its own golden beach, while further south along the coast is Patong, known for its vibrant nightlife and shopping extravaganza.

The villa has four gabled pavilions scattered around the grounds. The classic architecture, along with high ceilings, polished wooden floors and antique art pieces collected by the owner over the years, create an interesting atmosphere.

The dining area is spacious with high ceilings and polished wooden floors and has large glass doors that open onto a wide terrace with sea views and direct access to the pool.

The heart of the villa is the cozy family living room overlooking the infinity pool and the ocean. Two oversized sofas with cushions for lounging are arranged around a coffee table, perfect for chatting, reading or watching a movie on the large flat-screen TV.

The 4-bedroom Villa Napalai is located in a private hillside estate with magnificent views of the Andaman Sea, a short walk from Surin Beach.

The two sea-facing guest rooms feature king-size beds, en-suite bathrooms and balconies. Another guest bedroom has twin beds and opens out onto a garden terrace.

description:

The villa’s interior is imbued with attention to detail and refined style. Its six spacious bedrooms (5+1), each with an en-suite bathroom, provide complete comfort and privacy. The second floor is dedicated to luxurious spaces for relaxation and activity. It includes a beauty salon with a hairdressing station and massage table, an open yoga area overlooking the golf course, and a gym where everyone can find their ideal spot for exercise. The property also features a barbecue area, wine refrigerators for collectors, and a spacious living room with a marble fireplace and a large television, creating a warm and inviting ambiance.

The villa’s outdoor space is equally impressive: a large saltwater pool (85 sqm) with a jacuzzi, a gazebo with an outdoor bed for relaxation, and beautifully landscaped surroundings.

Technology and comfort — everything is done using the most modern solutions. The villa has a smart home system with sound for all rooms, video surveillance, electronic locks and electric curtains. High-quality materials are felt in every corner of the house: branded textiles and furniture, premium appliances (Smeg, Liebherr, Dyson). For your convenience, there is automatic watering, a socket for electric cars and a garage for two cars with a place for a motorcycle.

description:
Villa Sai Taan is a 5-bedroom elegant villa located in the prestigious gated Sai Taan complex next to Laguna in a picturesque part of Phuket.

Designed in a contemporary architectural style with tropical decor elements, it combines comfort, aesthetics, and complete privacy. The perfect choice for large families or groups of friends.

The villa's design features light tones, emphasizing natural light and spaciousness. Panoramic windows highlight the tropical lifestyle atmosphere, while views of the pool and manicured garden create a sense of peace and comfort.

The spacious open-plan living room combines lounge and dining areas for 10 people. It includes a large comfortable sofa, coffee table, chest of drawers, TV, sound system, and air conditioning, with glass doors leading to the poolside terrace. The interior is complemented by natural material decor and thoughtful lighting.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped to European standards with everything needed for comfortable living:

description:
Trichada Tropical 12 is a single-story 3-bedroom tropical villa located in the gated Trichada Breeze community, just a 5-minute drive from Layan Beach and the renowned Laguna Phuket district.

Villa perfectly balances contemporary comfort with authentic island ambiance. The ideal choice for families, couples, or small groups who appreciate aesthetics, privacy, and the serene beauty of southern Phuket.

Every detail of the villa's design has been meticulously crafted in light pastel tones featuring natural wood and eco-friendly materials. Subtle pastel interiors are accented with vibrant decorative elements, giving the space distinctive character and personality.

Five-meter ceilings, expansive panoramic windows, and soft lighting create an airy sense of space and harmony with nature. From the living room and bedrooms, guests enjoy picturesque views of the turquoise Balinese-tiled pool and tropical garden, evoking warmth and tranquility.

The expansive open-plan living room seamlessly integrates lounge and dining areas for 8 guests. It features a plush sofa, stylish coffee table, large TV with multimedia system, and air conditioning.

Wide glass doors open onto the pool terrace, flooding the room with natural light and creating a seamless connection with the garden.

The contemporary kitchen is fully equipped to European standards with all essential appliances and tableware:

Functional zoning and ergonomic design make it perfect for casual home cooking or hosting dinners with a private chef.

The villa offers 3 spacious bedrooms, each with direct access to the private pool and garden. Rooms are styled in pastel tones with wood accents and soft lighting, featuring air conditioning, ample storage, and modern ensuite bathrooms.

Master Bedroom: King-size bed, spacious walk-in closet, shower bathroom, and direct terrace access to the pool.

Second Bedroom: Cozy room with Queen-size bed, large bathroom, and views of the lush garden.

Third Bedroom: King-size bed, terrace access, and private bathroom.

At the villa's heart lies a private turquoise-tiled pool surrounded by manicured greenery.

The adjacent terrace features soft lounge chairs, sun loungers under umbrellas, ceiling fans, and a barbecue area — perfect for poolside breakfasts, candlelit dinners, or relaxed evenings with friends.

The villa is situated in the Trichada Breeze community — one of the island's most sought-after and well-appointed neighborhoods.

Just 5 minutes by car to Layan and Bang Tao beaches, Boat Avenue shopping district with restaurants, cafés, and bars, and the 5-star Laguna Phuket resort.

Trichada Tropical 12 is where modern comfort meets natural harmony. Here you can immerse yourself in tropical luxury and tranquility, savoring every moment of your escape. The perfect choice for those seeking a stylish villa for a peaceful Phuket retreat.

Sai Taan Villa 46 is a 6-bedroom villa located in the gated Sai Taan complex near Laguna in one of Phuket's most scenic areas.

Within the complex, guests have access to 24/7 security and covered parking.

The villa is located in the Sai Taan complex in Bang Tao — one of Phuket's most popular and well-appointed areas.

Ocean House is a newly built 3-bedroom townhouse in the "Best of Laguna" collection, located in the popular and secure "Laguna Park" complex. This cozy townhouse is fully equipped with everything necessary for comfortable living (including mosquito nets on the windows). It is ideal for a large family or a group of friends. The design and interior match the level of a 5-star hotel. The townhouse offers Wi-Fi, a Smart TV, a safe, a laundry area, a fully equipped kitchen, maid service, a swimming pool, and recreation area on the territory of the complex. The beach is nearby, and there is infrastructure for children and parents. Everything you need is here—come and enjoy a carefree holiday.

The living room is decorated in a light marine style and offers: comfortable furniture, a modern TV, a floor lamp, a coffee table with handmade elements and decor on the walls. There is also a dining area with a dining table for 6 people. The living room and kitchen have access to a cozy terrace with garden furniture, there is also a barbecue where you can cook healthy seafood and vegetables on the grill. There is a private parking lot in front of the house..

For those who prefer to cook at home, the kitchen is fully equipped according to European standards:

All three cozy bedrooms have private bathrooms, each of them can comfortably accommodate 2 people. Two bedrooms are located on the second floor, and one - on the third.

The master bedroom is equipped with a large King Size bed, a dressing table for ladies, a modern TV and has its own dressing room with an iron and ironing board, and the bathroom has everything you need, including bathrobes, a hairdryer, towels. The light interior elements, such as a beautiful floor lamp and self-illuminating candles, create a romantic atmosphere.

The second bedroom is decorated in airy light colors, equipped with a Queen Size double bed, a dressing table, and a large wardrobe.

The third bedroom is equipped with two single beds, a wardrobe.

Also on the third floor there is a balcony and a spacious terrace with a large sofa for relaxing and sunbathing, an umbrella and a table.

Guests have access to the staff of Get Your Phuket, the company that manages the "Best of Laguna" homes and ensures your carefree holiday experience. Enjoy the comfort and vibrant decor of Ocean House!

The Laguna Park complex is located in the heart of the famous fashionable area of ​​Laguna Phuket. Just 10 minutes' walk along the sidewalks and paved paths will bring you to one of the island's most picturesque beaches, Bang Tao. Its azure ocean waters and white sandy beaches are truly breathtaking.

On the well-kept and guarded territory of the Laguna Park complex there is a common swimming pool with a children's area, a terrace with sun loungers and a playground.

name: Bang Tao — Fortuna Luxury Trichada Villa · 3 bedroom
description:
Fortuna Luxury Trichada Villa is a modern, elegant 3 bedroom single-story villa designed by a famous local designer, known for his style, combining modernity and traditional Thai culture. The 3-bedroom villa is located just 5 minutes drive from Layan Beach and the fashionable Laguna area, surrounded by lush tropical gardens.

Pitched roofs over the main living areas emphasize the tropical lifestyle. The villa is designed in light colors. Panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows open up a stunning view of the pool with turquoise Balinese tiles.

The spacious living room has a view of the garden with a pool and is equipped with a comfortable sofa, coffee table, TV and dining table.

The kitchen is fully equipped according to European standards, equipped with all necessary appliances and connected to the living room.The spacious living room has wide sliding doors that lead to a beautiful pool terrace surrounded by tropical plants, where you can soak up the sun on comfortable soft chairs or hide in the shade under an umbrella by the sun loungers.

There is also the opportunity to dine outside in the well-kept garden.

The villa's layout provides privacy in all bedrooms. The rooms are bright and cozy with large double beds, bedside tables, stylish lamps and wide sliding doors with a beautiful view of the garden.

All three bedrooms are equipped with large double beds and private bathrooms.

The villa is located on the island of Phuket, close to Bang Tao Beach and Laguna. Just 3-4 minutes away you will find many clubs, beaches and resorts, as well as restaurants and bars with a wide variety of culinary specialties.

description:

name: Bang Tao — Angsana Lake view Royal Villa 116/19 · 4 bedrooms
description:
Angsana Lake View Royal Villa 116/19 is a spacious 4-bedroom family residence located in the prestigious 5-star Angsana Villas complex, in the heart of the Laguna Phuket resort.

This two-story villa is designed in a modern Asian style, combining homely warmth, premium comfort, and picturesque views of a tropical lake. It is the perfect choice for a large family or group of friends who appreciate developed infrastructure and high-level service.

The villa’s design features light, natural tones and high-quality natural materials, emphasizing harmony with the surrounding environment. Panoramic windows and spacious terraces on both floors flood the space with natural light, while views of the calm lake and tropical garden create an atmosphere of serenity and privacy.

The villa offers two living areas for maximum guest comfort.

Ground Floor: A bright living room connected to the kitchen, with direct access to the pool.

Second Floor: An additional cozy living area opening onto a scenic terrace.

Both zones are furnished with plush sofas, TVs, and air conditioning, creating ideal conditions for social gatherings or quiet relaxation.

The modern kitchen on the ground floor is fully equipped for a comfortable stay:

The space is thoughtfully designed to make cooking your favorite meals easy and enjoyable, even while on vacation. Nearby there is a dining area for 8 people with a view of the pool.

The villa features 4 comfortable bedrooms intelligently distributed across two floors. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning and wardrobes.

Ground Floor: A bedroom with a Queen-size bed — ideal for guests or elderly family members as it requires no stairs. A bathroom with a shower is located nearby.

Master Bedroom: A spacious room with a King-size bed, terrace access, and a private ensuite bathroom.

Two Guest Bedrooms: Cozy and bright rooms sharing a common bathroom on the floor.

The villa’s focal point is the private ground-floor terrace with a personal pool and lake views.

Here you will find sun loungers and a cozy gazebo (sala), perfect for enjoying morning coffee or evening cocktails in the fresh air.

The villa is situated in one of Phuket's most sought-after locations — Laguna Phuket.

5 minutes to Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket shopping galleries with restaurants and Villa Market supermarket.

7 minutes to the pristine white sands of Bang Tao Beach and beach clubs like Catch, Xana, and Maya.

Angsana Lake View Royal Villa 116/19 is where family comfort meets the privileges of a 5-star resort. Here, you can enjoy the privacy of your own villa while having the entire infrastructure of Laguna Phuket at your fingertips. The ideal choice for those seeking a carefree, vibrant, and stylish vacation in Phuket.
